name: base44
description: Connect Base44 to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Base44 MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Base44 to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with aI app builder using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Base44 workspace.
Find anything in Base44 that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review aI app builder in Base44.
